heading: Our People
intro_paragraphs: We are committed to investing in our people and strengthening our community.
Rooted in Rochester, NY with a global perspective, we support local initiatives, foster a culture of inclusion, and create meaningful impact where we live and work.

paragraphs: Our story begins in the cobble stoned streets of a Sicilian patisserie, where the Vigneri family first fell in love with the art of confection.
In the scent of warm pastries and the flicker of old ovens, a legacy of sweetness began to rise.
With hands guided by tradition and hearts full of dreams, the Vigneri name became known for its devotion to the craft.
sections.title: OUR ROOTS

items.text: Our vision is to be an industry leading chocolate brand known for craftsmanship, creativity, and care while building a farmers-first, sustainable future through ethical sourcing and responsible practices.
items.title: VISION

items.text: Our focus is to combine passionate people, innovative craft, and sustainable practices to create chocolate with purpose and care.
items.title: FOCUS

items.text: We passionately handcraft the highest-quality chocolates and deliver the sweetest, most memorable experiences to our customers.
items.title: MISSION

items.text: We stand by our promise of quality, care, and food safety in every step.
items.title: Integrity

items.text: We bring passion to our craft and encourage fresh ideas every day.
items.title: Inspire

items.text: We choose the purest, most sustainable ingredients to create with purpose.
items.title: Ingredients

items.text: We think ahead and push boundaries to craft the future.
items.title: Innovation

items.text: We grow by investing in our people, our partners, and our community.
items.title: Invest

paragraphs: Our values are the key ingredients in our chocolate and in everything we do:
sections.title: Our Values
